question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**transition**" refers to the process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another, which is appropriate for describing the shift to digital training due to Covid-19.
 
• "**End**", "**set**", and "**stagnation**" do not fit the context as they do not describe a process of change.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** "*As a result of Covid-19, the quick transition__ to digital training has exposed the hazards of student disengagement and........."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Set (स्थापित करना)**: To put something in a particular place or position.
 
• **End (समाप्ति)**: The final part of something.
 
• **Stagnation (स्थिरता)**: Lack of activity, growth, or development.
